summary: Keep mission-root tree state, summaries and queue order without full work presentation enrichment

replay.detail: This changes a read-only mission-root query. It adds no replay, rehydration or read-triggered repair, and no recovery wait.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, triggers, migrations or schema version changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, canonical claim selection or coordinated membership changes.

compatibility.detail: GET /v1/mission-runs?root= still returns the complete ordered array of descendants with effective step state, progress/completion summaries, queue labels/positions, run provenance, loops, outcomes, scheduler faults and gate annotation. Tree steps no longer populate execution start, wake, ready age, timeouts/extensions, fresh context, person answers or under fields; optional/default fields can disappear and execution_elapsed_ms is always serialized as 0. The individual mission-run and work-item detail routes retain full work presentation. Human st missions show keeps queue labels and ordering; st missions show --json reads the individual run route. Pairings with older CLI, stui, iOS and other clients have not been runtime-validated; consumers that require omitted tree fields must use the existing detail routes.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption or startup recovery is introduced by this read change. Restart-to-API and restart-to-health times for the candidate have not been measured.

manual.detail: No database or identity conversion is required. Integrations that consume work presentation fields from the root-tree response must instead read GET /v1/mission-runs/{run} or GET /v1/work-items/{subject}, as appropriate, before relying on those values.

recovery.detail: This read-only change persists no new state and requires no migration undo or added recovery procedure. It does not establish swap-back compatibility for other changes in an upgrade interval.
